text:
on the Munger Partnership's back-to-back 30% drawdowns in 1973-1974 with OPM, and the "math of losses"

>"it didn't bother me with my own money, but it made me suffer the tortures of hell as I thought through the loss of morale of the limited partners who had trusted me"

>drawdown math in 1973-1974 (2nd photo)...Y1 turns $1.00 into 68 cents, Y2 into 47 cents, and then even after a 73.2% gain in Y3, you're still 20% off peak.
